note: Times are reel-relative seconds, half-open. Narrative order. No shop footage exists in this drop (Act 1.1/1.4 missing).

selects.label: arrival-greeting
selects.quote: Is that you, Gail?... What a beautiful spot... It is one of God's many places

selects.label: gail-lightsup
selects.quote: It lights up my heart... many of them don't have family and just need to feel connected and that somebody cares... the music starts and the toe starts tapping... you can just feel that connection

selects.label: sixtyandchange
selects.quote: One of our group members came up with the name, Sixty and Change... some of us have more change than others... we're up for change... so much in life we haven't had the chance to do until we retired

selects.label: music-medicine
selects.quote: I'm a research gal... doctors are prescribing music for Alzheimer's patients... music's medicine just like flowers... different neural centers light up... like fireworks

selects.label: noidea
selects.quote: Do they have any clue what's going on? No idea... I told them I had to move the car for a delivery... a little floral musical surprise for Trish

selects.label: car-reveal
selects.quote: This is incredible... Isn't it pretty? I've been practicing... Let's go in and surprise... you take the lead, my love

selects.label: approach
selects.quote: Let's go, my darling... you know she has nobody. She'll be so surprised. Let's win the surprise out, eh?

selects.label: hearts
selects.quote: And hearts - how did you know? I didn't... they're very special to Trisha and I. We see hearts everywhere. We gather heart rocks. It's our thing

selects.label: surprise
selects.quote: Hey ladies!... we're here to celebrate all of you... It's not a new ukulele, but it's still played... It's a heart... the ukulele works. Not very well, but neither do I

selects.label: meant-to-be
selects.quote: The opportunity just came to me and I think it's meant to be... we are so very grateful and wanted to do something special for you

selects.label: inspiration-bcam
selects.quote: You're our inspiration, you're our heart and soul. Following your mom's dream

selects.label: soul-sisters
selects.quote: I am so touched... on this journey with yourself and Elaine and Donna and Lynn... we're soul sisters... I believe with all my heart and soul that kindness and love is the most important thing

selects.label: mom-story
selects.quote: Mom had a twenty year journey with Alzheimer's... we would still wheel her down to the music and mom's toe would be tapping... as mom lost her memories, the music was always there... I knew I wanted to do something special like that

selects.label: recruitment
selects.quote: The hard recruit started... Christmas is coming, maybe you could ask for ukuleles... our first go was the tenth of January 2023. Now we have over twenty performances... hundreds of songs

selects.label: our-dream
selects.quote: I said, do you know what, girls? I'd love to play for seniors... you had a dream in your heart. And we made that come true... it's as much of a gift to us as it is to the people

selects.label: gail-closer
selects.quote: Flowers are good for the soul... music is good for the soul. It really is medicine... maybe some people will be inspired to give back... we're all connected

selects.label: mom-lookingdown
selects.quote: Trish - sure your mom's looking down on you today. Yeah, that's exactly it

selects.label: gail-tapping-meet
selects.quote: We met online during COVID... a Tuesday night online tapping group... didn't meet in person until three years later... the journey unfolded from there

selects.label: gail-soulfood
selects.quote: Music is soul food... it started with Trisha's dream when her mum was in long-term care for twenty years... music lit her up... to honor her mother. She wanted to keep it going

selects.label: gail-family
selects.quote: We've lost family members, some of us have had serious illnesses... it's about so much more than just the music... we really consider ourselves a family and feeling pretty blessed

selects.label: gail-blownaway
selects.quote: She has absolutely no idea what's going to happen in a very few minutes... she will be blown away. It's our special way of saying thank you

selects.label: family-not-blood
selects.quote: We really are a family. You know, family's not always blood... something that could represent our bond... we're all on this journey together

selects.label: scale-decision
selects.quote: We've got a performance coming up, right?... could we do something with flowers to join us together, 'cause we are a family... Girl, I gotcha. Something just clicked in my dear old mind... for the five of you. And with you at the show

selects.label: trish-impact
selects.quote: The music starts and you see the spark in their eye... people jump up and dance... sometimes tears... 'you played my favorite song, I remember learning that at the piano with my mom'... knitting generations and memories... helping seniors feel valued

selects.label: trish-notwork
selects.quote: People say this is good work - it's not work. It's spreading the joy and being kind and caring for people

selects.label: neville-parallel
selects.quote: When I walked in and heard the ladies tiptoeing away on their ukuleles, I wanted to jump right in... flowers and music dance so wonderfully well together to feed the soul

selects.label: secret-kept
selects.quote: My darling, wasn't that fun?... It was so hard to keep it secret... they were genuinely really surprised, weren't they? They really were
